name: Rate Media
definition: User wants to provide a rating for a media item such as a book, album, or movie.

name: Play Music
definition: User wants to play a specific song, album, or artist.

name: Book Reservation
definition: User wants to make a reservation at a restaurant or venue.

name: Weather Inquiry
definition: User wants to know the weather forecast for a specific location and time.

name: Add to Playlist
definition: User wants to add a specific track or artist to a designated playlist.

name: Find Item
definition: User wants to locate a specific item, such as a book, painting, or soundtrack.

name: Show Schedule
definition: User wants to see the schedule for movies or events.
